lesson.title: Credit and insurance
lesson.summary: Distinguish creditworthiness, fraud detection and life/health insurance purposes.

prerequisites.reason: Creditworthiness is examined as a listed-use match rather than a product classification. Insurance is examined as a listed-use match rather than a product classification.

blocks: The **credit use** in Annex III 5(b) concerns evaluating a natural person's creditworthiness or establishing their credit score. The point expressly excepts systems used to detect financial fraud.
Northbridge's fictional lender must separate repayment-risk scoring from fraud detection. The exception is purpose-specific; it does not exempt every product marketed to financial institutions.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex III 5(b), 5(c); Article 6(2), 6(3)

blocks: The **life/health insurance use** in point 5(c) concerns risk assessment and pricing in relation to natural persons for life and health insurance.
Do not silently expand this exact point to every insurance product. Other functions can still meet another listed use or other law. Record the insurance type, person and output purpose.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex III 5(b), 5(c); Article 6(2), 6(3)

blocks: A combined tool both detects suspicious transactions and evaluates creditworthiness. The fraud purpose does not erase the separate credit function.
For each function, retain inputs, personal evaluation and its role in eligibility or pricing. A final human reviewer does not automatically remove the intended evaluation purpose.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex III 5(b), 5(c); Article 6(2), 6(3)

blocks: Compare the precise Annex III point before the later paragraph 3 and profiling checks. A not-listed result under one point is a narrow conclusion, not a general compliance certificate.
Changing from fraud flags to repayment scoring or life-insurance pricing changes the facts. Northbridge should update the record rather than copy the old exception.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex III 5(b), 5(c); Article 6(2), 6(3)

questions.prompt: A lender's tool predicts a person's repayment ability. Which purpose is directly relevant?

options.reason: The actual repayment evaluation is the listed purpose.

options.blocks: The fraud exception solely from the bank context
options.reason: The exception depends on detection purpose, not industry alone.

options.blocks: No relevant purpose if a person approves
options.reason: Human approval alone does not remove credit evaluation.

variants.prompt: Does creditworthiness evaluation become fraud detection simply because a bank operates the tool?

options.blocks: The fraud exception solely from the bank context
options.reason: The exception depends on detection purpose, not industry alone.

options.blocks: No relevant purpose if a person approves
options.reason: Human approval alone does not remove credit evaluation.
The actual repayment evaluation is the listed purpose.

questions.prompt: Which insurance types are expressly named in point 5(c)?

options.blocks: Every kind of insurance without distinction
options.reason: That expands the point beyond its wording.
That is not the life/health purpose stated in the point.

options.blocks: Life and health insurance for natural persons
options.reason: Those are the named insurance contexts.

variants.prompt: Which insurance risk/pricing purpose does Annex III 5(c) specify?

options.reason: That is not the life/health purpose stated in the point.

options.blocks: Life and health insurance for natural persons
options.reason: Those are the named insurance contexts.

options.blocks: Every kind of insurance without distinction
options.reason: That expands the point beyond its wording.

questions.prompt: One tool detects fraud and also sets personal credit scores. What should the analysis retain?

options.blocks: Only whether the supplier calls it analytics
options.reason: A broad label cannot replace the use-case facts.

options.blocks: Separate the purposes and assess each relevant function
options.reason: The exception is not platform-wide permission.
That hides the listed credit evaluation.
